title: The Transformer Revolution, Part 1: Dynamic Processing through Output-Weight Interconnections
abstract: arXiv:2608.03921v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We reinterpret Transformer inference by developing a functionally equivalent mechanical-structural description of its functional architecture. Parameterized transformations of token representations, or transforming concepts, are identified with simple neural networks organized through output-input and output-weight interconnections. This redescription makes explicit an organizational feature that is not equally salient in the standard matrix description: during inference, the outputs of some networks determine the weights, and hence the transformations, of others. These output-weight interconnections generate prompt-dependent dynamic transformations and give rise to Sequence-level Interactive Dynamic Parallel Processing (SIDPP). translated_title: Transformer革命（第一部分）：通过输出-权重互连实现的动态处理
translated_abstract: 我们通过为其功能架构开发一种功能等价的机械结构式描述，对Transformer的推理过程进行了重新解读。令牌表示的参数化变换，即变换概念，被识别为通过输出-输入互连和输出-权重互连组织起来的简单神经网络。这种重新描述使一个在标准矩阵描述中并不那么显著的组织特征变得清晰：在推理过程中，某些网络的输出决定了其他网络的权重，进而决定了这些网络的变换。这些输出-权重互连产生了依赖于提示词的动态变换，并由此产生了序列级交互式动态并行处理（SIDPP）。我们证明，动态参数的数量随提示词长度线性增长，并可能达到与训练中固定的静态参数数量相当、甚至超过后者的规模，我们将这一现象称为强提示依赖性。
tldr: 该论文以机械结构视角重新解读Transformer架构，揭示推理时部分网络的输出会动态决定其他网络的权重，由此产生随提示长度线性增长、甚至可超过静态参数数量的动态参数，以及序列级交互式动态并行处理（SIDPP）机制。
en_tdlr: The paper reinterprets Transformer inference through a mechanical-structural description, showing that some networks' outputs dynamically determine others' weights, yielding prompt-dependent dynamic parameters that grow linearly with prompt length and may rival or exceed static parameters, enabling Sequence-level Interactive Dynamic Parallel Processing (SIDPP).
